# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 71 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 48 | Coptic

---

## Saying 71

Jesus said: "I will tear down this house, and no one will be able to rebuild it."

---

**Translator's Notes (LOGOS):**

- "Tear down" — more forceful than "destroy" for the demolition of a building
- "Rebuild" — compound form mirrors the action more precisely
- The brevity of Thomas's version is preserved; no explanation added
